name: Alistair MacLeod
bio:
Alistair MacLeod's motorsport journey began in a small village in the Scottish Highlands, where he spent his youth tinkering with farm machinery. This hands-on experience ignited a passion for engineering, leading him to pursue a degree in composite materials. Upon graduation, he joined a local racing team, honing his skills in composite fabrication and repair.

His approach to his role at Tickford Racing is characterized by meticulous attention to detail and a pragmatic problem-solving attitude. Alistair believes in the importance of teamwork and clear communication, always striving to create a collaborative environment. He is known for his ability to diagnose complex issues quickly and efficiently, finding innovative solutions that minimize downtime and maximize performance.

Alistair's distinctive characteristic is his unwavering dedication to his craft, coupled with his quiet determination to constantly improve. His colleagues admire his resilience and his ability to remain calm under pressure, making him a valuable asset to the team.

physical.description: Alistair is of average height with a sturdy build, reflecting years of physical labor.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn multi-tool.
Has a habit of humming traditional Scottish folk tunes while working.
Insists on using only a specific brand of epoxy resin.
